status_values: TEMPLATE (fields only, every bound null; the feasibility classifier evaluates no rule and marks every sample envelope_pending) | DECLARED (the orchestrator filled every bound after the Phase 4 xhigh decision and committed the file before any formal Phase 5 run; a change afterwards is a new envelope version)
scope: The physically supported cutting envelope for the WP-12 Phase 5 benchmark (spec 5.3 class 'physically_unsupported'): which knife orientations, board kinds, materials, digit counts and operation patterns the CURRENT law (law 8, tlmpm_v5, ruler_knife_v2_y, 1 mm particles, 4 mm grid, 0.1 ms, kinematic ideal tracking unless a rule says otherwise) is declared to support. A sample outside it is counted as physically_unsupported, never dropped and never counted as a controller failure. Values come only from the Phase 4 decision records (docs/reports/WP12_CUTTING_PHYSICS.md, the E1 protocol docs/evidence, the resolution study); this template carries the known pending statements as notes, not as bounds.

rule_semantics.parameter: a key of the sample's envelope_parameters (generalization_wp12.envelope_parameters); a rule whose parameter the sample does not carry is NOT_APPLICABLE
rule_semantics.when: optional {parameter: value} conditions; the rule applies only if every condition equals the sample's value
rule_semantics.kind: max: value <= max | min: value >= min | range: min <= value <= max | in_set: value in values | subset: every element of the value list is in values
rule_semantics.null_bound: a null bound is UNDECLARED: the rule is NOT_EVALUATED and the sample is marked envelope_pending (never silently supported or unsupported)
rule_semantics.evidence: the record that justifies the bound (report section, evidence file, commit)
